scopes.reason: Sends listens to ListenBrainz using each user's own token.
Needed for lyra.listens.all. It only watches for new listens and never changes them.
Submits new listens for every user who has added a ListenBrainz token.
Needed for lyra.playback_sessions.all. It only watches what's playing and never changes it.
Sends the current track as 'playing now' for users with a token.
